I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: all PAgents register their executable capabilities in a matchmaking registry designated as the MarketPlace

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Uses recursive employment contracts (EmNet) forming dynamic hierarchies, a data-space marketplace broker, and fuzzy goal functions; no formal model-based product agent representation.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: The EmNet framework enables the dynamic organization of production resources through the recursive propagation of employment relationships throughout the entire vertical hierarchy.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Claims MHAgent is critical for intra-plant MES.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: the inclusion of the MHAgent is a critical element for the successful implementation of an intra-plant MES.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: Kovalenko, I.; Tilbury, D.; Barton, K. The model-based product agent: A control-oriented architecture for intelligent products in multi-agent manufacturing systems.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: The relation-forming phase results in an employment network that temporarily binds parties and enables dynamic reorganization.
